(2) translate_result cleared asset/relation candidates so Phase1B never wrote Asset/Version/Evidence; orm_written true from artifact-only. Fix: make_context_bundle_ref single source; Executor/Runtime use Registry ref only; translate_result preserves candidates; book_overview maps structured claims to Candidate Assets; evidence coercion+snapshot enrichment; persistence_complete requires candidate+evidence+artifact; empty_dto rejected.
